create_PrependDataset: create a PrependDataset that prepends a token index to each item in a wrapped dataset
build_PrependDataset_with_getter: build a PrependDataset using a custom prepend_getter function to determine which token to prepend per index
test_PrependDataset_getitem: test the PrependDataset __getitem__ method to verify it replaces the first token with the prepended index
review_PrependDataset_ensure_first_token: review the PrependDataset ensure_first_token_is parameter that asserts the original first token matches an expected value
summarize_PrependDataset: summarize the PrependDataset class that wraps a dataset and prepends a token to each item's source sequence
